class: A descriptive radio-group name replaces the enclosing field question
symptom: ADP's required Hispanic/Latino question remained unanswered even though the saved profile supplies No. The radios were classified under the explanatory definition rather than the question.
site: Church Mutual ADP EEO; output/Churchmutual_Looking_to_join_a_vibrant_organization_that_makes_a_difference/pages/20261025_150804/page_02.txt and subsequent EEO snapshots
root_cause: The snapshot parser trusts a named radiogroup or the nearest text. A description between a marked question and its radios overwrites that context, including when the description itself becomes the group's accessible name.
why_tests_missed: Existing regressions recover radio option labels from validation errors and retain questions across list items, but do not place explanatory prose between an enclosing question and a named/unnamed radio group.
fix: Retain explicit question text within its immediate enclosing structure and use it when a following group borrows intervening explanatory text. End scope at peer/outer boundaries, preserve independently named questions, and avoid interpreting generic starred section headings as questions.
prevention: Test question ownership independently of option-label recovery, including descriptions, nested groups and adjacent unrelated fields. Compare parser changes against saved real pages before accepting broader grouping changes.
